slices.title: Union growth, ASR wiring, and the Qwen preset
slices.intent: Add asr to the modality union and order, asr apply/remove cases, TokenPlanActions setter, UI label and icon, and the full qwen-token-plan preset entry.

symbols.name: TokenPlanModality
symbols.expectation: Union includes asr alongside llm image video tts webSearch.

symbols.name: MODALITY_ORDER
symbols.expectation: asr sits between tts and webSearch.

symbols.name: TOKEN_PLAN_PRESETS
symbols.expectation: Contains the qwen-token-plan preset with the five frozen targets.

symbols.name: applyModality
symbols.expectation: Handles the asr case writing provider qwen-token-plan-asr config with enabled true.

(

symbols.name: removeModality
symbols.expectation: Handles the asr case clearing key and base url with enabled false.
